RC1 · A REVIEW COPY FOR A SECURITY LEADER

Dear reader, would you read three chapters?

From the editor of The ultimate insider, a book about one day in which one person and a team of AI agents built a talk, with the record to prove it.

Why you
You carry the risk this book is about. If the controls in these chapters would not survive your audit committee, we would rather hear it from you now than from a reader later.
What we would like
Three chapters, about 52 minutes, by Friday 13 November 2026 (an example date: nothing has been sent), and your answers to a few questions at the end of each.
What you get back
your name in the acknowledgements, if you want it there
the first edition when it ships
a reply to every comment, and a page showing what your comments changed
